page0.text:
The sky was still pale gray.
Was it dawn or dusk?
It's hard to tell.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page0:1

page1.text:
The vast sky overhead, and a wide field stretching out on all sides...
The sky seemed close enough to touch.
Clouds...low enough to grab hold of.
This was one of the battlefields she fought on.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page1:1

page2.text:
But there was no longer any cavalry in her service.
The sprawling, golden meadow was gone.
Instead, unfolding under the dull sky...
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page2:1

page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page3:1

page4.text:
No emotion.
She must have seen this kind of thing almost daily.
Her desolate heart was empty.
As she leaned against the golden sword, she exhaled deeply, and let her shoulders relax.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page4:1

page5.text:
The battle must have ended.
After glancing over the bodies of the defeated soldiers, she returned to her camp.
Those were the battles she experienced.
Her cold, calm demeanor remain unchanged.
No matter the predicament she's been in, she remained just like the woman I've always known.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page5:1

page6.text: And then I see the dream of a king.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page6:1

page7.text:
The moment she drew the sword, she stopped being human.
She took over for her father as a feudal lord, and became a king with many knights.
She was known as King Arthur, and Altria. The life of the girl who once aspired to be a knight changed so radically.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page7:1

page8.text:
She acted like she was the king's son.
The ruler of territories and knights had to be male.
Only her father and the mage knew the king was female.
She covered herself in iron and hid that truth for the rest of her life.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page8:1

page9.text:
There were those who had their suspicions.
But the King of Knights who wielded the sacred sword knew neither injury nor age.
Excalibur was blessed with the protection of the fairies, making its possessor immortal.
As such, nobody questioned her tiny frame, which was much too small for a knight, or her face, which may have appeared girlish. Instead, she was hailed as a truly beautiful king.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page9:1

page10.text:
And in fact, the king was invincible.
Neither size nor appearance mattered.
Those who lived in fear of the savage invaders desired a strong king, and the valiant knights would follow only a truly superior leader.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page10:1

page11.text:
The king satisfied each of these conditions.
And so, nobody questioned the king's identity.
It did not matter if the king was a child, or a woman.
All that mattered was that the king protected the nation.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page11:1

page12.text:
The new king was fair and selfless, and always stood on the front line, fighting and defeating the nation's enemies on the battlefield.
Many enemies and citizens died, but the king was always just, and she played her role as king better than anyone else.
There was no room to suspect otherwise, and any such suspicions would be pointless while the king was right in any case.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page12:1

page13.text:
She knew no defeat on the battlefield.
Her army reformed the lost cavalry, then charged across the battlefield, defeating foreign infantry and smashing through their defenses.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page13:1

page14.text: Did she always stand on the front lines because her nation was behind her?
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page14:1

page15.text: Before she headed out to battle, she had to cast aside so many citizens.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page15:1

page16.text: Once she was on the battlefield, she had to cut down all her enemies.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page16:1

page17.text: As her battles were fought in defense of her nation, it was common to wring villages dry to support the army.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page17:1

page18.text: In that sense, no knight killed as many as she did.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page18:1

page19.text:
I can't tell if she ever really felt that burden.
It's not something I can really know from a dream.
But I do know she didn't have a moment's doubt or hesitation on the battlefield.
Grief never touched her thoughts when she sat on the throne.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page19:1

page20.text:
A king is not human.
Human emotions would make it impossible to protect people.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page20:1

page21.text:
She kept to her oath, never wavering.
She addressed the issues facing her nation, and she worked on matters of political concern.
She ruled without wavering, and she punished the deserving without error.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page21:1

page22.text:
And after winning so many battles, unifying so many clans, and punishing hundreds of criminals...
"King Arthur doesn't have a human heart."
One of the knights in her entourage murmured this.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page22:1

page23.text:
Everyone must have felt the same way.
The more perfectly she carried herself as a king, the more everyone questioned their monarch.
There is no way someone devoid of human emotion can rule humans.
Several reputable knights left the white castle of Camelot, but the king accepted this as inevitable, and incorporated it into her rule.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page23:1

page24.text: And so the fair king, once so admired by her knights, began to isolate herself.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page24:1

page25.text:
Such trivialities were of no concern to the king.
Even if she was deserted, feared, or betrayed, her heart would remain unchanged.
It couldn't be helped.
The moment she took that sword, she abandoned her emotions.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page25:1

page26.text: And then her final battle began.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page26:1

page27.text:
The battle at Badon Hill ended in a complete victory, and that inescapable conclusion led to the savage clans finally offering peace.
And so, the nation that had been holding its breath, waiting to be destroyed, knew a moment of peace.
The age of warfare where a nation leaned on a singular hero, came to an end.
Britain was finally going to become the nation she'd always dreamed of.
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page27:1

page28.text:
...The scene starts to fade away.
I realize the dream is ending and I'm about to wake up.
I can feel myself drifting closer to wakefulness.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page28:1

page29.text:
But before that happens, something really pissed me off.
...She's stupid.
Oh, she's strong, and a gifted fighter.
But there's a difference between being good at fighting and being cut out for it.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page29:1

page30.text:
The people around her pissed me off too.
If she didn't notice it, someone else around her should have told her, or she would go on making the same mistake forever.
Seriously...how the hell did she have so many people around her, and not one told her the truth?
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page30:1

page31.text:
...
I wake up.
We escaped Illya's forest and returned home yesterday afternoon.
Tohsaka went back to her room, complaining her stomach hurt, and my headache wasn't getting any better, so we all decided to just go to sleep.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page31:1

page32.text:
It must have been the extra weight I was lugging around.
As soon as I got into bed, I couldn't get back up.
Saber was the only one who seemed fine, and Tohsaka and I left her to guard the house while we slept. And then...
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page32:1

page33.text:
"So I slept for half a day. At least my headache's gone."
I'm relieved.
The whole thing with Berserker...
The headache I got after copying Saber's sword was unreal.
If It had kept up, my head might well have just split down the middle.
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page33:1

page34.text:
Then I notice…
"Huh!?"
Saber is sitting on the floor, right next to my head.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page34:1

page35.text:
"...Sa...ber? Why're you glaring at me like that first thing in the morning? Did something happen while I was asleep?"
"...No. I simply had a dream."
"Hm?"
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page35:1

page36.text:
"...No, it is nothing. Let us have breakfast. It is time to wake up."
Saber gets up and heads silently out of my room.
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page36:1

page37.text:
"What was that about?"
I don't know why Saber's acting strange.
I'm really not sure, but...
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page37:1

page38.text:
"If she was sitting by my bedside the whole time...was she nursing me back to health?"
The moment I have that thought, the scene from last night comes back to me.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page38:1

page39.text:
"Wha... What the hell am I thinking!?"
I shake my head to rid myself of those impure thoughts.
That night, my contact with Saber was entirely about my duty as a Master.
If I don't rationalize it like that, I'll never be able to look at Saber again.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page39:1

page41.text:
"Calm thoughts... Calm thoughts.
We acted normal when we were coming home yesterday.
That's all I need to do."
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page40:1

page42.text:
No, I was actually just tired yesterday. But I still need to act normal.
...Besides, Saber wouldn't like me acting like this.
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page41:1

page43.text:
"Okay. I just need to calm down and make breakfast."
I take a deep breath and get changed.
It's nine in the morning.
Saber hasn't eaten since lunch yesterday, so she must be hungry.
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page42:1

page44.text:
Nine is so late, it's practically not even morning anymore.
As hungry as Saber must be, I should probably make a hearty breakfast.
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page43:1

page45.text: "Shirou. Is it just you and I this morning? Do we not need to wake Rin up?"
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page44:1

page46.text: "No, everyone's still asleep. Considering what happened yesterday, it's probably best to let them sleep. I'll leave their food out, and they can eat whenever they like."
page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page45:1

page47.text:
"I see. Then I would appreciate it if you prepared the meal quickly. It is much later than usual."
"I know. I feel better now, so let's head to the dojo once we finish eating."
page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page46:1

page48.text:
"Eh? The dojo? Do you intend to continue your training with me?"
"Why not? It's our daily routine."
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page47:1

page49.text:
"What's wrong, Saber? Did I say something weird?"
"Oh...no. I just assumed we would no longer be training.
With Berserker defeated, I thought there would be no further reason for you to continue training as we had been."
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page48:1

page50.text:
"I see. You know, you may be right."
The common enemy we all share in Berserker is gone now.
We teamed up to take on an enemy far stronger than us, and that's also why I trained so furiously in such a short period of time.
page50.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page49:1

page51.text:
"Hmmm, but I'd like to keep training. I'm still an untrained mage, and I get to see the real you when you wield a sword. That makes it easier for me to talk to you too."
Well, I say easy, but what I mean is that I kind of enjoy it.
page51.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page50:1

page52.text: "Huh. So I reveal my true self when I am in the dojo?"
page52.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page51:1

page53.text:
"You sure do. At least you don't hold back.
I prefer it that way. Besides, I think you get to loosen up as well. Anyway, our routine has been us sparring in the mornings. Don't take the few pleasures I have."
page53.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page52:1

page54.text:
I take the ground beef and pork, green onions, mushrooms, onions, and eggs out of the refrigerator and head to the kitchen.
All I need is panko, sake, and cooking oil...
page54.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page53:1

page55.text:
"Well, then...I have no objections."
"Hm?"
Saber mumbles quietly to herself in the living room while I work.
I can't quite hear what she's saying from the kitchen.
page55.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-13:page54:1
